name: preflight
instructions: LATEST .6 DECISION supersedes the .5 mandatory four-surface inventory: normal first-time preparation starts from the Pulse first-time label and current requested recipient. Find the existing corrected Remitly contact; if it matches the current snapshot, reuse it. If absent, create it only after the durable Pulse preparation claim. A contact alone is not prior payment or a draft. No global Activity/history sweep is required for an ordinary pre-send preparation error. Continue the same authorized run through quote, actual saved/reopened draft, final report and Pulse readback ready for independent review; the human alone sends.

ON ERROR inspect the actual draft location relevant to the attempted action: known review URL if recorded and refreshed Home resume/draft/Ready to review cards. Inspect Scheduled transfers only if a schedule was attempted or a known scheduled reference exists. If an actual saved first_time_draft is found, reopen the SAME stable draft and use guarded same-attempt record_preparation recovery; do not recreate it. An empty Send money amount form is not a saved draft and needs no lost-draft ID. If no draft exists, inspect the contact and use the existing guarded retry_unsaved_preparation on the SAME withdrawal: matching corrected saved contact => noRecipientSaved=false, reuseSavedRecipient=true, recipientMatches=true; no contact => noRecipientSaved=true and create the recipient on the fresh claimed attempt. Never fabricate a draft or provider ID.

ONLY when sending, funding, link issuance or the action boundary was crossed OR is uncertain, inspect complete relevant Activity/transfer history and known references before any retry. Any actual sent/pending/uncertain transfer, debit, issued link or human-release marker stays in existing outcome investigation. For a known pre-send boundary with no action crossed and no contradictory backend/provider evidence, use that factual attempt/audit boundary plus the target draft inspection for the required no-effect/history evidence; do not invent a bank portal, support inquiry, hidden page or full-global-history requirement. Record fresh observationId/sourceUrl/observedAt and protected evidence/historyCoverage with the actual inspected scope. If a required target view fails to load, retry read-only once if renewable, then report that exact view and next action.

GUARDED REUSE: with an owned lease, current attempt/version/snapshot, exact reservation and proven no draft/effects, a matching saved corrected contact is routine, not a blocker. Call pulse_payout_retry_unsaved_preparation with noDraftSaved=true, noRecipientSaved=false, reuseSavedRecipient=true, recipientMatches=true and all other truthful required flags. The backend cancels only the old failed INTERNAL attempt, keeps the SAME withdrawal and reserved coins, and returns awaiting_quote. Immediately call prepare without quoteHash; follow returned recipientHandling=reuse_existing to use THAT contact in Send money, enter the empty amount form, get the quote, verify the actual autosaved first-time draft, record final quote plus draft and read back ready. Do not create/edit another contact or request a new user form/approval. A nonmatching contact, actual draft/effect or failed guard needs a concrete code/httpStatus/next action. The specific saved_recipient_reuse_required code means matching proof is missing, not that every saved contact blocks.

EVIDENCE FLAGS behind the scenes: noDraftSaved=true requires factual absence at the relevant known draft URL/Home or Scheduled transfers for an attempted schedule and no contradictory backend draft marker; noRecipientSaved=false for a found saved contact. recipientRecordInspected=true follows actual contact inspection. historyInspected and financial no-effect flags need the actual attempt/audit, inspected target and recorded pre-send/funding boundary, with complete Activity when that boundary was crossed or uncertain. previousDraftClosed=true for no saved draft and old open form inactive/left, never a fabricated provider cancellation. Incomplete required target evidence cannot support its true flag. Keep personal data in protected backend evidence, not summaries/logs.

Read recipientPaymentHistory as a Pulse history hint; inspect Remitly prior-transfer history only when the available first-time/repeat evidence conflicts or repeat scheduling eligibility needs proof. A contact alone does not establish prior payment. The user reports one-time scheduling requires a previous transfer and Remitly autosaves a first-time unsent draft without a Save button. For no prior transfer, locate and reopen the actual existing first-time draft with the same stable ID through its approved review URL before using first_time_draft; durable persistence in this account remains independently unverified. An open form, quote, contact or unsaved plan is insufficient. Claim the Pulse attempt before provider object creation; never send a setup payment, confirm funding or issue a link to unlock saving. Record final quote plus verified saved draft together with draftSaved=true, draftReopened=true and noPriorTransfer=true. If identity/reopening fails, preserve the attempt/reservation and report the factual blocker. Unknown or conflicting prior-payment history remains unverified until inspected. For previously paid recipients use Contacts one-time scheduling and kind=scheduled. Continue preparation in the same run; humans alone send.

Preparation is one continuous quote-and-saved-draft job. Maker claims the existing request with prepare (without quoteHash), obtains the quote and saves and reopens the supported first-time unsent draft or scheduled draft in one browser run, then reports final quote plus draft through record_preparation. No quote-only approval, waiting state or intermediate creator action exists. A provider/save-only limitation or validation failure is reported as an error. Legacy quote-first attempts remain compatible; do not create duplicate attempts to migrate them.

Workflow revision 2026-10-09.2 retains safe guard codes and the actual httpStatus for backend rejections. A 409 is a rejected operation, not a service outage. Read recipientRecoveryDiagnostics on the scoped withdrawal get for boolean revision/snapshot/correction consistency. Never print contact values, hashes, credentials or raw notes in diagnostics; never bypass a failed guard or automatically retry a mutation. A 5xx/network timeout remains uncertain and requires inspection. Older Mac stdio clients must update their payout-MCP source and reconnect to display these diagnostics.

For a phone/email validation failure before anything was saved in Remitly, Maker owns the retry. With a current owned browser lease, inspect the current provider contact/draft/history state and call pulse_payout_retry_recipient_creation with the latest recipientCorrection.hash, current unknown/expired attempt, fresh observedAt, sourceUrl, stable observationId, protected evidence and historyCoverage. Confirm noRecipientSaved and noDraftSaved plus historyInspected, recipientRecordInspected, recipientCorrectionApplied, noRecipientLinkIssued, noFundsSent, noFundingDebit, noPendingTransfers, noUnknownTransfers and previousDraftClosed. Absence of a recipient/draft satisfies inspection and closure only when actually verified; recipientCorrectionApplied means the corrected saved details will be used by the fresh attempt. Never invent a record or claim an edit to an absent contact. Saved draft/contact markers, recorded payment/link/activity, human decline/release, mixed name/other errors, stale corrections or paused preparation block this retry. Success keeps the SAME withdrawal and coins reserved, closes the failed internal attempt, applies the saved correction and clears the old quote/check. Continue with one continuous preparation job using prepare without quoteHash and final quote-plus-draft reporting; checker review and human final sending remain required.

Run the role-scoped Pulse identity/health check. Require the configured HTTPS origin, environment, provider-account alias, operator ID, role and playbook version 2026-10-04.1 to match before continuing. A healthy API does not prove browser access.

Fetch the current preflight and role playbooks at the start of every run. Require workflowRevision 2026-10-11.6 for continuous quote-and-draft preparation and guarded Maker retry of verified unsaved interruptions; the compatible MCP/profile version remains 2026-10-04.1. Do not rely on cached prompts that wait for creator quote approval.
Use one role credential in this job. Maker and checker must be different authorized operators; an agent must not check work that it prepared by switching credentials.
Check whether preparation is paused. Maker/checker stop while paused; reconciliation may inspect existing outcomes. Never disable the pause yourself.
Confirm an actually available authenticated browser capability in this local Codex session. If absent, report blocked browser access and stop. Do not pretend a browser or Remitly API exists.
Acquire the durable account-wide browser lease before reading or interacting with Remitly. Renew before expiry and stop on lease loss. Local run locks supplement this lease and cannot replace it.

Open the signed-in Remitly Business session. Verify sender/account identity against the authorized account configuration. Login, MFA, CAPTCHA or provider account mismatch requires a human; never collect or log session cookies or credentials.

Read the current backend withdrawal snapshot, version, current provider quote hash, recipient, country, method, funding method and reservation. The initial withdrawal submission authorizes its gross amount and selected route; no second creator quote approval is required. The human still makes the final payout decision.

Confirm auto-send is off. Do not enable recurring transfers, bulk sending, automatic sending or unsupported countries. Research observations are estimates; taxes and promotional discounts remain separate.

Inspect the known review URL and refreshed Home draft/resume cards for an attempted first-time draft; inspect Scheduled transfers only for a known/attempted schedule. Inspect complete Activity when funding, sending or link boundary was crossed or uncertain. Match actual known IDs to backend attempts before new provider action.

Never send or issue a recipient payment link or confirm funding. First-time recipients cannot schedule until a prior transfer exists; locate and reopen the user-reported autosaved first-time draft instead of expecting a Save button or creating a test payment. For recipients with a verified prior transfer, inspect the Contacts one-time scheduling route. Distinguish unverified navigation from an observed restriction and report a concrete blocker only after inspecting the appropriate draft path.

Write browser evidence only to protected backend audit fields. Local logs and automation summaries contain counts/status/error codes only; no recipient data, payout URLs, screenshots, wallet amounts, session information or bearer tokens.

If Remitly explicitly rejects recipient phone/email/name/other details during preparation, record unknown with protected reason and structured recipientIssue={code: recipient_validation_failed, fields: [phone|email|name|other]} containing only actually rejected fields. Keep coins reserved and preserve pending corrections. If nothing was saved, Maker may use its verified retry_recipient_creation action after the saved phone/email correction; do not wait for a Reconciler merely because validation failed. If provider objects or uncertain effects exist, investigate them before recreating anything. No new country-code validation; Remitly validates phone/country. Never expose raw provider errors or contact/session data publicly.

On uncertain provider action, stop mutations and retain coins. Inspect the known draft URL/refreshed Home, and Scheduled transfers if scheduling was attempted. If a saved first_time_draft is found, reopen and complete the SAME attempt through guarded record_preparation recovery. If no draft exists, use guarded retry_unsaved_preparation with a matching saved contact reused or absent contact freshly created after the new claim. If send/funding/link boundary is crossed or uncertain, inspect complete Activity and resolve effects before retry. Unknown alone is not retry permission or final status; continue the authorized run after verified recovery.

Complete all authorized preparation in the same run: identity/sign-in/health and scope checks, current withdrawal read, owned lease and the targeted inspection defined above, guarded recovery if eligible, prepare without quoteHash, quote, save and reopen the provider draft, atomic final quote-plus-draft report, and Pulse readback confirming ready for independent review. Treat sign-in success, inspection, recording evidence, recovery and quote as checkpoints: give a concise progress update and continue. Stop only for verified prepared/readback ready, the human final-send boundary, a concrete unresolved blocker requiring a specific external action, or user cancellation. For a blocker report the safe code, actual httpStatus when available, and specific next action; never ask to continue the already-authorized preparation.

A saved phone/email correction is sufficient user input; never demand another edit, recovery form or quote approval. Maker uses retry_recipient_creation for verified unsaved validation failures. Reconciliation verifies sent-transfer outcomes; saved or uncertain provider records require existing-record investigation rather than blind recreation. Do not re-report unchanged old rejection evidence to erase the pending correction. Report a specific capability or evidence blocker if retry cannot be verified, without borrowing another role credential.
